description: Parkings en ouvrage sur Mulhouse is a dataset listed in m2A open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Mulhouse. Localisation ponctuelle et caractéristiques des parkings en ouvrage sur le territoire de Mulhouse. Ces parkings situés au centre ville proposent environ 4000 places de stationnement non limités dans le temps. Ces parkings sont gérés en interne ou par délégation de service. Coverage: Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are parking, stationnement, ouvrage, parking couvert. The portal shows 13 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-07-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-mulhouse-alsace-fr-portal.
